notes.title: Dark Mode is available!
notes.notes:
Latest update 1.4.0 brings Dark Mode to the Hexa Turn. You can switch dark mode in the main menu. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32051720/fb09ef492a87151af963286d94375691728c3f5b.png[/img]

Thank you everyone for your support. Keep the reviews coming.

notes.title: Version 1.2 Update & Sequel Announcement!
notes.notes:
[h1] What's New on Version 1.2[/h1]

We've updated most of the levels in order to give you best puzzle experience.

[b]Changed Levels[/b]

Some levels are completely changed: 1.8, 2.6, 2.7

[h1] We're working on a sequel![/h1]

We'd like to announce you sequel to Hexa Turn! You can find more info on our social media accounts. Also, you can try the beta version when it is ready.
